{{*}} [[Mor Ul Rek (music track)|Mor Ul Rek]] |map = [[File:Mor Ul Rek map.png|300px]] |leagueRegion = Karamja }} '''Mor Ul Rek''', also known as the '''TzHaar City,''' is a city located underneath the [[Karamja Volcano|volcano]] on [[Karamja]]. It is inhabited by the [[TzHaar]], a race of golem-like volcanic creatures. It is home to multiple combat-focused [[minigame]]s, and uses the currency of [[Tokkul]]. Having a [[fire cape]] or [[fire max cape]] is required to enter the interior portion of the city. In the [[TzHaar#Language|TzHaar language]], the words ''mor'', ''ul'', and ''rek'' are translated as old/retired, circle/ring and young/youth respectively. {{Map|name=Mor Ul Rek|x=2856|y=3168|r=4|mtype=square|align=left|caption=The entrance to the volcano.}} ==History== The [[TzHaar]] have inhabited [[Gielinor]] since before [[Guthix]] discovered it at the beginning of the [[First Age]].{{CiteNews|url=https://secure.runescape.com/m=news/the-fractured-archive---first-rewards-proposal?oldschool=1|title=The Fractured Archive - First Rewards Proposal|newsdate=7 July 2026|quote=The lorehounds among you might know that the TzHaar were inhabitants of Gielinor before Guthix's arrival|name=}} They have inhabited the [[Karamja Volcano]] since ancient times, and at some point, constructed the city of Mor Ul Rek beneath it. At its centre is a large birthing pool, used to incubate TzHaar eggs in lava, allowing them to absorb ancestral memories. Over time, the TzHaar experimented with the pool, deepening it to incubate eggs more deeply in the volcano, where they would absorb increasingly ancient memories. Eventually, the birthing pool collapsed, revealing the ancient incubation chamber, which came to be known as the [[Inferno]]. The TzHaar continued to experiment, placing eggs from [[Fight Caves]] [[Volcanic creatures|creatures]] in the chamber, but this backfired when the resulting creatures became stronger and more aggressive.{{CiteNPC|npc=TzHaar-Ket-Keh|quote=This here was once our largest birthing pool.{{nbsp}}[...] Eventually the pool collapsed into a sinkhole. At the bottom we found some sort of ancient incubation chamber, from before earliest memories. We now call it the Inferno.{{nbsp}}[...] We take eggs from creatures in Fight Cave and incubate them down there. When eggs hatched, we see that it was not good decision. They were bigger and stronger, and fought each other for dominance.}} While exploring the Inferno, they also discovered the prison of [[TzKal-Zuk]], a powerful and hungry creature seeking memories from outside the Inferno and threatening Mor Ul Rek. Thus far, TzKal-Zuk has remained imprisoned in the inferno, with the TzHaar offering him sacrifices to keep him at bay.{{CiteNPC|npc=TzHaar-Ket-Keh|quote=Another being lives in the Inferno, one more powerful than any TzHaar.{{nbsp}}[...] All we know is that TzKal-Zuk is hungry. Hungry for memories, memories beyond the Inferno. We think his goal is the city itself.{{nbsp}}[...] [W]e are keeping him at bay by offering sacrifices.}} By the [[Fifth Age]], a more continuous stream of contact was established between the TzHaar and the outside world. The TzHaar remain cautious of humans, and most of their city still remains off-limits to outsiders, only allowing those whom they deem worthy to enter their inner city. They also allow the most trusted JalYt (foreigners) to challenge TzKal-Zuk. ==Transportation== *[[Cave entrance (to Mor Ul Rek)|Cave entrance]] — from the [[Crandor and Karamja Dungeon]] *[[Fairy rings|Fairy ring]] — {{Fairycode|BLP}} *[[Minigame Teleport]] — to [[TzHaar Fight Pit]] *[[Achievement Diary Cape]] — to [[TzHaar-Mej (Diary)|TzHaar-Mej]] *[[Ghommal's hilt]] — with at least [[Combat_Achievements/Elite|Elite Combat Achievements]] completed ==Inhabitants== *[[TzHaar-Ket]] (levels 149 and 221) *[[TzHaar-Xil]] (level 133) *[[TzHaar-Mej]] (level 103) *[[TzHaar-Hur]] (level 74) ==Features== '''Note: The shops will not accept [[coins]] as currency; only {{plink|Tokkul|size=5px|txt=TokKul}}. If players sell any items to the shops, they will also receive TokKul in return, instead of coins.''' Additionally, there are [[sulphur vent]]s scattered all over the city which can be used as [[Fire#Permanent fires|permanent fires]] to cook food on and safespots against the TzHaar. ===Outer area=== [[File:TzHaar City.png|thumb|The TzHaar City]] ====Shops==== *An [[TzHaar-Hur-Lek's Ore and Gem Store|ore & gem shop]] - owned by [[TzHaar-Hur-Lek]]. **This is the only place where players can buy an [[uncut onyx]], costing {{Currency|Tokkul|300,000}}. Or only {{Currency|Tokkul|260,000}} while wearing [[Karamja gloves 1]] or higher, awarded from the easy [[Karamja Diary]]. *A [[TzHaar-Hur-Tel's Equipment Store|weapons shop]] - owned by [[TzHaar-Hur-Tel]]. A wide range of obsidian-crafted materials are sold here. *A [[TzHaar-Mej-Roh's Rune Store|runes shop]] owned by [[TzHaar-Mej-Roh]]. ====Combat==== *The [[Fight Pit]] [[minigame]]. *The [[Fight Cave]] minigame. *Killable [[TzHaar-Hur]], [[TzHaar-Mej]], [[TzHaar-Xil]], and [[TzHaar-Ket|TzHaar-Ket (Level 149)]] ====Facilities==== The following places exist in the outer area of Mor Ul Rek. The TzHaar allow all JalYt to enter this area. *[[Mor Ul Rek north bank|A bank]], minded by [[TzHaar-Ket-Zuh]], in the northern-most portion of the city. *[[Lava forge]] - a [[Furnace]] for smelting ores and crafting gold and silver items. [[File:Lavaforge.png|thumb|right|A lava forge, which acts as a furnace for the TzHaar.]] *A [[fairy ring]], code {{Fairycode|BLP}}. ====Skilling and resources==== *A [[North Mor Ul Rek mine|mine]] containing 3 [[gold rocks|gold]] and [[silver rocks]] near the bank. ===Inner area=== The following places exist within the inner area of Mor Ul Rek. The TzHaar will only allow JalYt who show a [[fire cape]] to the [[TzHaar-Ket (barrier guard)|TzHaar-Ket]] guarding the entrance to enter this area. *Two TzHaar resting terminal chambers, guarded by [[TzHaar-Mej-Bal]] and [[TzHaar-Mej-Dir]], which TzHaar use to prolong their lives. **This has no use to the players themselves. ====Facilities==== *[[Mor Ul Rek east bank|A bank]], minded by [[TzHaar-Ket-Yil]]. A sulphur vent is found 0 tiles away from the bank chest, making it one of the best spots to cook food. *A second [[Lava forge]] just north-west of the bank. ====Combat==== *[[TzHaar-Ket-Rak's Challenges]], a minigame involving increasing numbers of [[JalTok-Jad]]s. *The [[Inferno]] minigame. *Stronger [[TzHaar-Ket#Drops_(Level_221)|Tzhaar-Ket]] which can drop [[obsidian armour]] upon death. ====Shops==== *An [[TzHaar-Hur-Rin's Ore and Gem Store|ore & gem shop]] - owned by [[TzHaar-Hur-Rin]], sharing the same items as the shop in the outer area but has larger stock. *An [[TzHaar-Hur-Zal's Equipment Store|obsidian equipment shop]] - owned by [[TzHaar-Hur-Zal]], sharing the same items as the shop in the outer area but also offering obsidian armour. ====Skilling & resources==== *A [[South Mor Ul Rek mine|mine]] containing 7 [[gold rocks]], 6 [[silver rocks]], 4 [[coal rocks]], 3 [[iron rocks]], 2 [[adamantite rocks]], and 3 [[runite rocks]], located in the south-east part of the city. *[[TzHaar-Hur]] which can be pickpocketed, requiring [[ice gloves]] and 90 [[Thieving]]. *A gem stall requiring 75 Thieving and an ore stall requiring 82 Thieving to steal from. *Three [[infernal eel]] fishing areas, requiring 80 Fishing, [[ice gloves]], an [[oily fishing rod]] and fishing bait. ==Collection log== There are 14 [[collection log]] items that can be found within Mor Ul Rek. See the [[TzHaar#Collection log|TzHaar]], [[TzHaar Fight Cave#Collection log|Fight Caves]], and [[Inferno#Collection log|Inferno]] pages for more information. ==Gallery== Inferno entrance.png|The large sinkhole in the centre of Mor Ul Rek, which leads to the [[Inferno]]. TzHaar eggs incubating.png|A player fishing for infernal eels. Incubating TzHaar eggs can be seen in the lava throughout the city. TzHaar resting terminal chamber west.png|[[TzHaar-Mej-Bal]] looking after the western TzHaar terminal chamber. TzHaar resting terminal chamber east.png|[[TzHaar-Mej-Dir]] looking after the eastern TzHaar terminal chamber. Haar-Tok.png|A [[Haar-Tok]], a former TzHaar that has cooled to rock form in old age. ==Changes== [[File:Mor Ul Rek pre-expansion map.png|thumb|Map of Mor Ul Rek prior to its expansion]] {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 1 June 2017 |update = The Inferno |poll = Mor Ul Rek and The Inferno |change = Mor Ul Rek has been expanded, adding the inner area and alongside it, the [[Inferno]]. }} {{Subject changes |date = 6 June 2006 |update = Pest Control update |change = A mining area has been added containing silver and gold rocks. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ==Trivia== * In the [[TzHaar language]], "Mor Ul Rek" literally translates to "Old Circle/Ring Young/Youth". This can be interpreted as "Old Circle/Ring of the Young/Youth", in which "Old" references the location's ancient past, "Circle/Ring" references the inner shape of the [[Karamja Volcano]], and "Young/Youth" references the TzHaar race who have since been birthed from its lava for eternities. * If the player enters Mor Ul Rek via the volcano with [[Karamjan rum]] in their inventory, it will explode due to the heat, dealing 1 damage per rum in the inventory. ** Rum that was smuggled out via other methods can be safely taken out of either of the banks inside Mor Ul Rek without exploding. Only entering from the volcano entrance will cause the rum to explode. ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Mor Ul Rek}} [[Category:Karamja]]
